methods.name: Caco-2 cell culture and lipid competition
methods.protocol_description: Human epithelial colorectal adenocarcinoma cells (Caco-2, ATCC) were cultured in DMEM with 10% FBS at 37°C with 5% CO2. Plates were seeded at 5×10^5 cells per 10 cm plate. For lipid competition, Sa (d18:0) (5 µM) and Sa (d17:0) (0, 5, 10, 50 µM) were added; cell pellets collected after 1 h. For isotopic labeling, [U-13C,15N]-serine (2.2 mM) was added with 5 µM Sa (d17:0); samples collected at 60 and 120 min.

methods.protocol_description: B. thetaiotaomicron strains were grown in minimal medium with 25 µM PAA, washed, resuspended in DMEM with 10% FBS, and added to upper-well inserts of 6-well transwell dishes with Caco-2 monolayers. methods.name: RNA-seq of Caco-2 cells
methods.protocol_description: RNA was isolated from Caco-2 cells incubated with BTWT or SLMUT in transwell plates using Trizol. Libraries were prepared with NEB Next Ultra RNA library kit and sequenced on Illumina HiSeq 2500 (50 bp single-end reads). Reads were mapped to human genome using STAR aligner.
